tooltip.chuanshuo.chuanshuo_doll: A little companion in your palm.
tooltip.chuanshuo.controls: Place on blocks. Click display to spin; sneak-click to retrieve. Fits helmet slot. Sneak-use in air to deploy. Click companion to pat; sneak-click to reclaim. Left-click your doll or display: laugh for 12 seconds.
message.chuanshuo.full: Make room in your inventory first.
message.chuanshuo.owner: This doll belongs to another player.
